summary_brief: AI Agent 基础设施向企业级安全与可控性迈进，主要体现在多代理系统的权限隔离（Profile、Worktree）、细粒度安全审查（非写权限变更检测）和人机交互确认（Workflow HITL）。同时，AI Agent 能力边界持续扩展，从本地文件系统操作向浏览器自动化、实时语音交互和批量任务编排演进，跨平台兼容性和成本优化也成为重要关注点。

engineering_signals.title: 多代理系统安全隔离与权限管控体系成熟
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同时推出安全隔离机制，包括 Profile 角色权限控制、子代理 Worktree 文件系统隔离、安全审查工作流自动化，标志着多代理系统从原型探索走向企业级安全部署，为大规模代理协作提供了必要的安全沙箱和治理框架。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 工作流人机交互确认（HITL）成为共识模式
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 和其他框架同时在工作流级别引入步骤级人工确认机制，允许在关键步骤前暂停并请求用户输入，这解决了自主 Agent 在高风险场景（如生产环境部署、敏感数据操作）中的可控性问题，是实现安全 AI 自动化的关键基础设施。

engineering_signals.title: CI/CD 成本优化与测试智能过滤
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目（gptme、LlamaIndex）同时推出针对成本和效率的优化方案，包括基于路径变更的智能测试过滤（节省 $30+/天 API 成本）、实验性测试隔离、Token Bucket 速率限制，表明 AI 工具在规模化应用中面临的经济性问题已成为工程优化的重点方向。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编程工具跨平台兼容性成为标准要求
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 集中修复 Windows 平台路径处理、CRLF 换行符和插件解析问题，加上 AsyncIO 垃圾回收 bug 的修复，表明 AI 编程工具正从 Linux/Mac 优先的开发者工具转向真正的跨平台生产力工具，Windows 企业用户的体验优化成为产品成熟度的标志。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 持久化记忆与状态管理模式确立
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 采用 Claude Code 的 MEMORY.md 模式实现子代理的跨调用知识累积，配合 Markdown Profile 配置（YAML frontmatter），标志着 AI Agent 从无状态交互向可学习的有状态系统演进，为构建专业化、知识密集型的 Agent 提供了标准化的持久化方案。

research_signals.title: AI Agent 操作能力从本地系统向 Web 浏览器扩展
research_signals.why_it_matters: Google Gemini CLI 引入实验性浏览器 Agent，配合 OpenAI Codex 的网络代理 MITM 支持和实时语音对话模式，标志着 AI Agent 正在突破本地文件系统限制，向通用 Web 自动化和多模态交互演进，这是实现真正通用 AI 代理的关键技术突破。

research_signals.title: AI 批量任务编排与大规模自动化管理能力浮现
research_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 引入从 CSV 生成批量子代理任务并导出到 SQLite 的功能，配合 Anthropic SRE Agent 实战教程的发布，展示了 AI Agent 从单点辅助向大规模任务编排和 DevOps 自动化演进的趋势，为 AIOps 的落地提供了技术路径验证。

research_signals.title: AI 文本生成检测与质量控制成为新方向
research_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 编辑器新增基于维基百科指南的 AI 写作检测与修正能力（24 种常见模式），配合 Agno 的细粒度指标追踪系统，标志着 AI 工具从单纯的生成能力向生成质量控制、检测和评估体系建设演进，反映了 AI 信任与可解释性研究的工程化落地。

research_signals.title: AI 辅助编码 CI/CD 集成进入生产就绪阶段
research_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 正式发布，配合 Slack 插件从临时版本迁移到官方稳定版本，以及 Cline 向多代理平台演进（Responses API、文件式 Agent 配置），标志着 AI 辅助编码从本地开发工具向生产级 CI/CD 基础设施转型，自动化 PR Review 和 CI 修复即将成为标准实践。

release_signals.title: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 正式发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: 标志着 Claude Code 在 CI/CD 自动化领域的成熟，通过统一接口和自动模式检测大幅简化了 AI 辅助编码的集成流程，为自动化 PR Review 和 CI 修复奠定了基础。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 引入远程控制与安全沙箱
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增的 `remote-control` 子命令和严格的安全沙箱机制（HTTP Hooks 域名白名单、环境变量显式授权）显著增强了企业级环境下的可控性与安全性。

release_signals.title: Agno 引入工作流级人机交互(HITL)

release_signals.title: Cline 引入 Responses API 与子代理配置

release_signals.title: OpenAI Python SDK 新增 Phase 接口
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增的 `phase` 接口（v2.24.0）及对 `gpt-realtime-1.5` 的支持（v2.23.0）表明 OpenAI 正在强化其 SDK 对实时交互和复杂推理阶段的管理能力。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `claude remote-control` subcommand for external builds, enabling local environment serving for all users.
- Updated plugin marketplace default git timeout from 30s to 120s and added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` to configure.
- Added support for custom npm registries and specific version pinning when installing plugins from npm sources
- BashTool now skips login shell (`-l` flag) by default when a shell snapshot is available, improving command execution performance. Previously this required setting `CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN=true`.
- Fixed a security issue where `statusLine` and `fileSuggestion` hook commands could execute without workspace trust acceptance in interactive mode.
- Tool results larger than 50K characters are now persisted to disk (previously 100K). This reduces context window usage and improves conversation longevity.
- Fixed a security issue where HTTP hooks could interpolate arbitrary environment variables from header values. Env var interpolation now requires an explicit `allowedEnvVars` list in the hook configuration.
- Fixed a bug where duplicate `control_response` messages (e.g. from WebSocket reconnects) could cause API 400 errors by pushing duplicate assistant messages into the conversation.
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID`, `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` environment variables for SDK callers to provide account info synchronously, eliminating a race condition where early telemetry events lacked account metadata.
- Fixed slash command autocomplete crashing when a plugin's SKILL.md description is a YAML array or other non-string type
- HTTP hooks are now routed through the sandbox network proxy when sandboxing is enabled, enforcing the domain allowlist. HTTP hooks are not supported for SessionStart/Setup events.
- The `/model` picker now shows human-readable labels (e.g., "Sonnet 4.5") instead of raw model IDs for pinned model versions, with an upgrade hint when a newer version is available.

key_changes: 新增 claude remote-control 子命令，支持外部构建和本地环境服务
修复 2 个安全漏洞：hooks 权限控制不严和 HTTP hooks 环境变量注入
插件市场优化：支持自定义 npm registry、版本锁定和超时配置（120s）
BashTool 性能提升：有快照时跳过登录 shell，工具结果持久化阈值降至 50K 字符
新增 SDK 账户信息环境变量，修复 WebSocket 重复消息导致的 API 400 错误
ai_summary.summary_cn: Claude Code v2.1.51 版本重点引入了 remote-control 远程控制功能，并修复了 2 个重要安全漏洞（workspace trust 和环境变量注入）。同时优化了插件生态（npm registry、版本锁定、超时配置），提升 BashTool 性能和系统稳定性，新增 SDK 账户信息环境变量以避免竞态条件。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

key_changes: 统一接口设计：将 mode、direct_prompt、override_prompt 等多个输入简化为单一的 prompt 输入，所有 CLI 选项通过 claude_args 统一管理
智能模式检测：移除手动 mode 配置，Action 可根据设置自动判断运行模式（交互式或自动化）
破坏性变更：废弃了 custom_instructions、model、allowed_tools 等 6 个输入参数，需使用新的 prompt 和 claude_args 接口替代

## Changes

### PR [#2021](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2021) by [jlec](https://github.com/jlec) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): Enhanced Azure AI Gateway with i18n Support and documentation

- Added configurable API version support for the Azure OpenAI backend, defaulting to `2025-04-01-preview` while maintaining backward compatibility.
- Implemented URL validation with HTTPS enforcement and a cancellable context in `SendStream` with a 300-second timeout.
- Added a 10MB response body size limit using `io.LimitReader` and improved error body truncation from 200 to 500 characters.
- Added file-level documentation across all backend files and enforced lowercase error messages per Go convention.
- Fixed Bedrock `max_tokens` to correctly respect `opts.MaxTokens` with a fallback, and added error checks for empty message lists across all backends.

# Changelog

## New Features:

- **PgVector**: added `similarity_threshold` parameter for filtering search results by minimum similarity score.
- **Team:** Added streaming event support for `TeamMode.tasks`, enabling real-time event emission during autonomous task execution.
- **Workflows HITL:** Add support for HITL in workflows at Step level to pause for confirmation and user input. See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/workflows/hitl/overview)

## Improvements:

- **Metrics:** Redesigns the metrics system to provide per-model, per-component granular tracking across the entire agent/team/workflow lifecycle.
- **WebsearchTools:** expose timelimit, region and backend params in `DuckDuckGoTools`
- **SeltzTools**: Updated to use Seltz SDK 0.1.3

## Bug Fixes:

- **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed to refresh AWS credentials on every Bedrock request when using boto3 session.
- **`@tool` decorator:** Fixed @tool decorator to not fail for Agent/Team type annotations
- **Pydantic model serialization:** Fixed Pydantic model serialization in tool cache.

## What's Changed
* chore: update quickstart by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6656

top_pain_points.review_reason: 包含明确崩溃和卡死问题：#49998描述连接channel时直接崩溃，#49961描述编辑器在使用时规律性卡顿约10秒（用户报告"regularly hangs"）。这两个问题都直接阻断编辑器正常使用，属于稳定性核心问题。虽count=2但影响严重，符合P0定义。

top_pain_points.topic: API response parsing crashes when backend proto changes
top_pain_points.review_reason: 7个issue证实用户在使用过程中遭遇CLI崩溃，属于主流程阻断性故障。高频崩溃直接影响用户完成任务的连续性，符合P0判定标准。

top_pain_points.topic: SDK crash on startup with AJV validation error (Agent SDK 0.2.27+)
top_pain_points.review_reason: Agent SDK在启动时崩溃，直接阻断用户使用Claude Code Action的核心功能。AJV验证错误导致整个工作流无法启动，用户无法完成代码审查等任务。4个issue证实这是高频且严重的问题。

CRITICAL production-blocking issues: Issue 35259 causes complete crash with TypeError when streaming Mistral with citations - user reports 'complete failure' affecting LangGraph agents. Issue 35395 is a REGRESSION in 1.2.14 that broke working code from 1.2.13 - tool args parse failed in streaming mode. User evidence shows parse output changed from valid JSON to broken data. Count=4 meets frequency threshold, and issues demonstrate complete functionality breakage, not just degraded performance.

top_pain_points.topic: OAuth authentication fails after successful login with 401 token expired errors
top_pain_points.review_reason: Authentication failure blocks users from accessing the application entirely. 3 separate issue reports confirm users complete login successfully but immediately receive 401 token expired errors, preventing any application usage. This is a critical blocker affecting the core user flow.
